objective: Make elapsed time a state-review checkpoint and absolute emergency ceiling rather than the ordinary primary exit.

selected_inputs.BULL: 25% partial at +24% ROE, residual floor +3% ROE, prior-peak giveback 6% ROE
selected_inputs.RANGE: full-position profit trail armed at +18% ROE with 1.5% ROE giveback
selected_inputs.BEAR: one-time completed 4h recovery-failure check: price return <= -2% and BB improvement <= 0.40

BULL_CONDITIONAL_EXTENSION.meaning: At the completed 12h review, exit only if both return and BB recovery remain below the configured thresholds; otherwise extend under residual/profit protection to the 24h emergency ceiling.

RANGE_RESOLUTION_OR_FAILURE.meaning: Exit earlier when mean reversion is objectively completed; at 6h exit a failed recovery; only unresolved middle states extend to 12h.

BEAR_RECOVERY_RESOLUTION.meaning: Countertrend recovery either fails at the completed 4h checkpoint, resolves through a large BB recovery, or enters a high-profit trail; 24h is only the final countertrend risk ceiling.

neighborhood.BULL: Chebyshev distance <=1 across review return and BB-improvement thresholds.
neighborhood.RANGE: Chebyshev distance <=1 across state target, review return, and review BB-improvement thresholds.
neighborhood.BEAR: Chebyshev distance <=1 across state target, profit-trail arm, and profit-trail giveback thresholds. The 4h failure checkpoint is a fixed completed 4h market-structure mechanism, not a tunable duration axis.

selection: Choose the simplest connected plateau passing every gate. Rank by worst-calendar mean net bps, then expectation retention, then drawdown, then lowest absolute-time-backstop rate, then key.
release: Lock one candidate per lane and a complete entry+exit fingerprint before opening the point-in-time 2020 holdout.
